summary: Single-person household with no children, $109,700 yearly household earnings, and a home they own. Every income-tested programme is out at this level: SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, EITC, the refundable child tax credit (no children), ACA premium tax credit (income is above the 400% FPL cap), and free school meals (no children). No programmes recommended. Nothing here needs a caseworker.
